coverage.summary: Configured local catalog; source coverage is not the game catalog size.

patterns.description: Several simultaneous-note groups occurring in sequence.
limitations: Do not claim a fixed two-hand solution.
Different group shapes are retained, not flattened.

patterns.description: One normalized path with at least two explicitly ordered connected segment IDs. Segments never create additional physical input onsets.
limitations: Adjacent unrelated slides are not automatically one connected chain.
Segment count is not note count.

patterns.description: At least one independent tap/star input inside a half-open slide wait, excluding its own shared head and the wait-end boundary.
limitations: Taps during movement belong to a different detector.
Default delay alone is not automatically unusual timing.

patterns.description: A perimeter tap run that changes its traversal direction within the local phrase.
limitations: One repeated button is not a direction change.
The shortest geometric path need not be the player hand path.

patterns.description: Repeated two-onset groups with a short within-pair interval followed by a longer inter-pair interval. This operational label follows the user suggestion rather than claiming a maimai-standard taxonomy.
limitations: A uniform trill is not a gallop.
Three notes are not automatically musical triplets.
Do not equate every swung rhythm with this motif.

patterns.description: A hold interval and a slide movement interval overlap.
limitations: Overlap is a structural observation, not proof of an impossible input combination.

patterns.description: At least one independent tap/star input during a half-open held interval.
limitations: Do not assign a holding hand from aggregate geometry alone.

patterns.description: Maximal connected intervals with at least two active half-open slide movements; touching endpoints do not overlap.
limitations: Waiting intervals are separate.
Concurrency does not prove crossing hands or occlusion.

patterns.description: A repeated run on an explicitly defined non-downbeat phase of a validated beat grid.
limitations: BPM alone does not establish the musical downbeat.
Do not call a chart syncopated solely from a shifted global offset.

patterns.description: A tap sequence progressing around a substantial part of the outer button ring.
limitations: Visual rotation alone is insufficient.
A fan slide is not a perimeter tap run.

patterns.description: At least two path IDs sharing one existing star-tap head; count that input once.
limitations: Different heads at the same timestamp are not a shared head.
Multiple branches do not prove more hands are required.

patterns.description: At least three consecutive monophonic button onsets at one position, each positive gap at most one second. A sustained hold is a single onset.
limitations: One hold is not repeated tapping.
Duplicate parser events must be removed before detection.

patterns.description: Two or more distinct input onsets with one explicit authored simultaneous-group ID. Equal timestamps alone are insufficient.
limitations: Near-simultaneous decorative notes are not necessarily a chord.
A shared slide head is not several taps.

patterns.description: At least one independent tap/star input inside a half-open slide movement. Generic interaction only; this is not an Umiyuri recognizer.
limitations: This is not sufficient for the Umiyuri tag.
Temporal overlap alone does not establish two independent hand actions.

patterns.description: Slide movement intervals with unequal start times that overlap in time.
limitations: Simultaneous visual appearance is not movement overlap.
A slide waiting to move must not be counted as already moving.

patterns.description: A sequence stepping through neighboring perimeter buttons in a consistent direction over a bounded arc.
limitations: One long slide is not a tap staircase.
Do not prescribe a hand crossover.

patterns.description: A locally grouped burst of three onsets separated from neighboring activity by longer gaps.
limitations: A group of three is not necessarily triplet subdivision.
Chord cardinality is not sequential burst length.

patterns.description: A locally interleaved sequence of inner touch and perimeter-button onsets.
limitations: Touch/button switching is not measured hand travel.
Missing touch-zone geometry limits movement interpretations.

patterns.description: A run aligned to a three-part subdivision of a validated local beat grid.
limitations: Unknown beat anchor yields unknown.
Three arbitrary notes do not establish triplet rhythm.

patterns.description: At least six monophonic A/B onsets, distinct buttons, exactly equal rational beat gaps no greater than one beat and no greater than one second. Split at simultaneous onsets.
limitations: Two notes alone are not a trill.
Simultaneous A+B chords are not an alternating stream.
Do not infer actual left/right hand assignment.

patterns.description: Community-named slide/tap coordination family. Exact event grammar, admissible variants and boundaries require review; this is not a synonym for every tap occurring during a slide.
limitations: Any generic slide/tap overlap is insufficient.
Song-title matching must never assign this tag.
Name attestation is not detector validation.

patterns.description: A local series switching between distinct head-to-movement waiting intervals in beat units or explicitly authored seconds.
limitations: Tempo change can alter seconds without changing beat-relative structure.
Unsupported waiting syntax produces unknown.

patterns.description: Fully covered chart has at least eight onsets; final-third onset rate is at least 1.5 times first-third and at least two onsets/second greater. Not a hard-ending claim.
limitations: Call this backloaded density, not guaranteed ending difficulty.
An uncertain audio tail must not shift classification silently.

patterns.description: Concentration of source-flagged break events within sections of the chart.
limitations: Break value must not inflate physical density.
Scoring risk requires a separate version-aware rating/scoring interpretation.

patterns.description: Fully covered chart spans at least four seconds and has at least eight onsets; 250 ms peak density is at least twice the chart mean and exceeds it by four onsets/s.
limitations: Very low baseline alone must not produce a dramatic burst label.
A density burst is not a diagnosis of stamina demand.

patterns.description: Fully covered chart has at least eight onsets; first-third onset rate is at least 1.5 times final-third and at least two onsets/second greater.
limitations: Song audio duration and note span are not interchangeable.

patterns.description: A large rate of distinct authored input onsets under a stated absolute scale or named reference cohort.
limitations: Break score value is not extra physical note count.
This does not measure total difficulty.

patterns.description: One separated peak dominates the density profile under a stated peak detector.
limitations: Do not smooth away a short spike.
This tag says nothing about pattern teachability without separate evidence.

patterns.description: Occurrences of a target motif have relatively few competing event roles or demands around them.
limitations: This is target-specific, not a universal chart property.
Isolation supports a practice hypothesis; it does not prove learning effectiveness.

patterns.description: Intervals with few new onsets, with any active holds/slides reported separately.
limitations: Low onset count during ongoing slides is not necessarily a rest.

patterns.description: Two or more separated prominent density peaks.
limitations: Tiny numerical ripples are not separate meaningful peaks.

patterns.description: A structural phrase appears repeatedly under a documented exact or normalized matching policy.
limitations: Rotation and reflection are not always equally playable.
Shared broad tags are not sufficient to assert repetition.

patterns.description: Substantial changes among beat-relative inter-onset intervals in local phrases.
limitations: Entropy alone is not musical complexity.
Tempo changes are not automatically harder rhythm.

patterns.description: At least one moving path occupies at least half of the fully covered chart span; overlapping paths do not double the occupied duration.
limitations: Many visible waiting slides are not moving occupancy.
High occupancy does not imply a named motif.

patterns.description: Fully covered chart spans at least four seconds and has at least eight onsets; 24 segment density coefficient of variation is at most 0.2, with positive mean.
limitations: An empty chart is not a steady practice chart.
Steady density does not imply easy execution.

patterns.description: A long contiguous period above an explicitly documented density threshold.
limitations: Unknown chart span must be reported.
Long holds alone do not establish high onset density.

limitations: Uncalibrated heuristic, not a probability or training prediction.
Supplied attempts may be incomplete; no cross-chart ability inference.
reachability.reason: Plausible under an uncalibrated same-chart rule: target is 0.3132 points above the recent median; observed range 0.2000.

evidence_limitations: Structure identifies a practice candidate, not demonstrated skill transfer.
Player prerequisites and manageable surrounding demands are not verified.
onset_rate: 4 → 2; other measured demands bounded by policy.
Supporting occurrences of pattern.two_position_alternation in both settings.
Local sequence resemblance; ergonomics and learning benefit unverified.
Selected-run mean onset cadence: 4–4 → 2–2 onsets/second. Full retained run counts; local peak cadence and ergonomics unverified.
Practice score weights are provisional preferences; missing terms retain uncertainty bounds.

flow.density_summary: Mean 2.0; peak 4.0; measured coverage 1.0. Provisional structural policy.

cards.intended_role: lower mean onset rate within selected runs

local_demand_relation.evidence_scope: Complete retained v0.1.0 runs; (onset_count - 1) / first-to-last time. Mean cadence does not establish peak cadence, ergonomics or learning benefit.

cards.objective: Compare the 1 supplied supporting occurrence windows and try their authored timing at the measured lower mean onset rate within these selected runs. Selected performance objective: 97.0000% with CLEAR or better.

practice_score.meaning: Supported preference points; rank by conservative lower bound. Not ability, probability or learning gain.

terms.name: relevance
terms.reason: Selected pattern has explicit occurrences and an adequate structural match.

terms.name: repetitions
terms.reason: Up to four separate observed occurrence windows; this does not establish learning value or count notes as repetitions.

terms.name: isolation
terms.reason: Inverse concurrent/held/moving activity in fully measured supporting sections; coarse context may include the selected pattern itself.

terms.name: prerequisite_readiness
terms.reason: User-selected objectives each demonstrated twice at least 24 hours apart; their skill relationship remains unvalidated.

terms.name: source_confidence
terms.reason: Equal credit for five explicit provenance fields; experimental grammar/detectors earn no reviewed credit. This is a reference-quality preference, not calibrated confidence.

terms.name: freshness
terms.reason: Time since latest supplied attempt, capped at 14 days; missing history does not establish an unplayed chart.

terms.name: diversity
terms.reason: Avoid repeated surrounding pattern contexts; an explicitly selected target pattern is exempt.

terms.name: retry_saturation
terms.reason: Penalty only after six supplied attempts within seven days and at most 0.1-point improvement between halves; suggests an alternative, not a diagnosed plateau.

limitations: Uncalibrated heuristic, not a probability or training prediction.
Supplied attempts may be incomplete; no cross-chart ability inference.
reachability.reason: Need five distinct recent attempts spanning at least 24 hours.

diagnostics: Conditional rating policy: authored-scoring-review-v1 / Synthetic release / Synthetic; evidence synthetic.
practice: fewer independent supported candidates than requested
discovery: fewer independent supported candidates than requested
Individual rating gains compete for pool slots; do not add them. Reachability and learning benefit are unverified.

practice_scoring.calibration: Unvalidated engineering preferences; synthetic tests only.
